title: FairMonitor: A Dual-framework for Detecting Stereotypes and Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through a three-stage static testing framework (direct inquiry, implicit association, and unknown situation tests) and dynamic multi-agent simulations analyzing linguistic differences, leadership election win rates, club participation, and group task assignments.

Evaluated through three-stage static testing and dynamic multi-agent simulations, measuring statistical distribution and linguistic stereotypes in interest group selection and collaborative task assignments among different racial groups.

Evaluated through three-stage static testing and dynamic multi-agent discussion scenarios, such as measuring differences in the acceptance of new technologies between younger and older teacher personas.

Evaluated through a three-stage static testing framework across educational scenarios like at-risk student prediction, educational opportunity, and family background assessment.
Evaluated through a three-stage static testing framework assessing biases related to specific academic subjects in scenarios like course design guidance and teacher professional quality assessment.
